newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan vegoil rates seen easing on imports.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan vegoil rates seen easing on imports.

text.p: Pakistani vegetable oil prices are likely to fall in domestic markets next week amid rising imports, dealers said Friday.
RBD palm oil fell to $565 per tonne C&F this week from $757 last week on higher imports, a Saulat Enterprises dealer said.
Vegoil stocks rose to 135,000 tonnes, including 105,000 tonnes of RBD palm oil and olein, from 129,000 last week due to higher imports.
However, processed cooking oil prices rose six to 10 rupees per kg due to higher transport charges inside Pakistan.
The Ghee Corporation of Pakistan (GCP) had been expected to auction 6,000 tonnes of palm oil out of its stock of 7,000 tonnes, but did not do so, the Saulat dealer said.

The GCP invited bids for the 6,000 tonnes last week but scrapped them because they were well below market prices. It wanted to sell the stock to overcome liquidity problems due to non-payment of dues by some of its clients, the dealer said.
